description.narrative: (Zambia): .Revenue for Growth (R4G) supports the Government of Zambia to increase domestic revenues and expand fiscal space for public spending and investments in service delivery and poverty reduction. The USAID partner engages both the government institutions and non-government stakeholders to build capacity in tax policy analysis, improve tax compliance and administration, and strengthen the tax culture. The activity further supports private sector and civil society stakeholders by facilitating effective dialogue and advocacy on taxation and to build coalitions that mobilize support for both revenue mobilization and broader fiscal policy reforms. With FY 2022 funds, this mechanism will partner with GRZ institutions to provide technical assistance to the Zambia Revenue Authority (ZRA) to improve operational systems, audit processes, and tax collection; support the Ministry of Finance and National Planning to develop effective tax policy and communicate reforms widely; and further work with the private sector and civil society organizations to improve their skills to analyze and report on fiscal policy and administrative issues. Under USAID/Zambia's Country Development Cooperation Strategy, the mechanism will support Development Objective 1: Citizen and National Self-Reliance Advanced by More Effective Accountable Governance. .. ...
